name: DR. A. P. J. ABDUL KALAM
description: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam was an aerospace scientist and statesman who served as the 11th President of India from 2002 to 2007. He played a leading role in India's space and missile development programmes through ISRO and DRDO and was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1997. He was widely associated with his vision for India's technological and national development.
alt: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

name: DR. RAGHURAM G. RAJAN
role: Former Governor, Reserve Bank of India
description: Dr. Raghuram G. Rajan is an economist and the Katherine Dusak Miller Distinguished Service Professor of Finance at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business. He served as the 23rd Governor of the Reserve Bank of India from 2013 to 2016 and previously served as Chief Economist and Director of Research at the International Monetary Fund.

name: DR. C. RANGARAJAN
role: Former Governor, Reserve Bank of India
description: Dr. C. Rangarajan is a distinguished economist who served as Governor of the Reserve Bank of India from 1992 to 1997. He subsequently served as Governor of Andhra Pradesh, Chairman of the Twelfth Finance Commission and Chairman of the Prime Minister's Economic Advisory Council. He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2002.

name: MOHIT MALHOTRA
description: Mohit Malhotra is a senior business leader associated with Dabur India. He previously served as CEO of Dabur India and was subsequently elevated to the role of Global CEO of Dabur. He has extensive experience in the consumer goods industry and international business.

name: MEERA SANYAL
description: Meera Sanyal was an Indian banker and public-service advocate who served as CEO and Chairperson of Royal Bank of Scotland India. She had a banking career spanning more than three decades, including senior roles at ABN AMRO and RBS. She later entered public life and was associated with the Aam Aadmi Party. She passed away in 2019.

name: DR. DUVVURI SUBBARAO
role: Former Governor, Reserve Bank of India
description: Dr. Duvvuri Subbarao is an economist and former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, serving from 2008 to 2013. Before becoming RBI Governor, he served as Finance Secretary and Secretary of the Department of Economic Affairs in the Government of India. He is an alumnus of IIT Kanpur and holds a PhD in Economics.
